question.text: In a triangle $A B C$, the sides $A B$ and $A C$ are represented by the vectors $3 \mathrm{i}+\mathrm{j}+\mathrm{k}$ and $\mathrm{i}+2 \mathrm{j}+\mathrm{k}$, respectively. Calculate the angle $\angle A B C$

solution.text: $A B=3 i+j+\hat{k}$ and $A C=i+2 j+i$ $8 A=-(3 i+j+k)$ $\angle A B C$ is angle between $B A$ and $B C$ $B C=A C+B A$ $=A C-A B$ $=\hat{i}+2 \hat{j}+\hat{k}-(3 \hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k})=-2 \hat{i}+\hat{j}$ $B A \cdot B C=|B A \| B C| \cos \theta$ $-(3 \hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k}) \cdot(-2 \hat{i}+\hat{j})$ $=\left(\sqrt{3^{2}+1^{2}+1^{2}}\right) \cdot\left(\sqrt{2^{2}+1^{2}}\right) \cos \theta$ $\Rightarrow \quad 6-1=\sqrt{11 \times 5} \cdot \cos \theta$ $\cos \theta=\frac{5}{\sqrt{55}}=\sqrt{\frac{5}{11}}=\theta=\cos ^{-1}=\sqrt{\frac{5}{11}}$
